about: Curated reputation gates for the Codex (tools/lib/codex/build.js, loadRepGateTable): the standing a vendor (npcs), an NPC handing an item out (npcs) or a quest (quest) asks before the item, where no release-safe data source records it (a server-side vendor gate: the client's ItemSparse has no MinReputation for these, and Forever's item data shows none). faction: Faction.dbc id (data/forever/factions.json); standing: 1 Hated .. 8 Exalted; npcs: the item's vendors at that faction (an item both sides sell has a row per faction); quest: the quest whose reward it is (choice: a choice reward). Each row cites a public page for the standing: warcraft.wiki.gg, else classic reputation guides or QuestieDB as the note says. Facts only. The standings are Classic's: Forever's item data (envChange, read 2026-10-14) shows no reputation change for any of these items. A row whose item, vendor or quest the Codex lacks is a codex build warning.
